events.title: Canyon Lake Annual Pass
events.description: JBSA Recreation Park at Canyon Lake Purchase a Joint Base San Antonio Recreation Park at Canyon Lake annual pass for $100 for you and a spouse and enjoy the lake all summer. This pass gets you into both Sunny Side and Hancock Cove. Otherwise, the daily entry fee for the park is $15 per visit, per vehicle. Annual passes include a vehicle and boat/trailer pass and are valid for one year from date of issue for daily use only, during the hours we are open. You can also buy a dependent pass for an additional $35 as long as they are over 18 and have a valid DoD ID card. For more information, please

events.title: Riding Lessons
events.description: JBSA-Fort Sam Houston Equestrian Center Whether you’re a beginner or an experienced rider, the JBSA-Fort Sam Houston Equestrian Center offers horseback riding lessons for all skill levels in both English and Western styles. Lessons are available by appointment only, with horses, saddles, and tack provided for each session. Riders must be at least 7 years old to participate. Private lessons are $60 per hour, semi-private lessons are $50 per rider, and group lessons are $40 per rider. Be sure to ask about available package deals!

events.title: Missions E-Bike Tour
events.description: JBSA-Lackland Outdoor Rec. Oct 24 | 8:30AM-3PM $30 per person. Price includes transportation, a bike, and safety equipment. sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS orders, CAC, medical and dental records, birth/marriage certificates if applicable, and all travel vouchers for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your assigned unit upon arrival. Visit the Military Personnel Section within 24 duty hours for personnel actions, ID card updates, and DEERS enrollment.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Housing (210-671-1840) before arrival for on-base assignments. Unaccompanied housing available for eligible E1-E3 Airmen. Temporary lodging: Gateway Inn (210-671-3731).

sections.title: Permanent Party vs. Training
sections.body: BMT graduates follow-on to technical training. Permanent party Airmen coordinate with gaining unit and sponsor before arrival. AETC reporting instructions differ from AMC/ACC bases.

sections.body: Key contacts: Security Forces 210-671-2018 | Housing 210-671-1840 | MPF 210-671-6006 | WHASC Medical 210-292-7412 | FSS/MWR 210-671-3722.
